svg.title: Sentinel-FZ Scalable System Design
svg.desc: Full system design diagram showing ingestion, AI engine layer, processing engines, storage layer, and dashboard with horizontal scalability indicators

g.text: Kafka / RabbitMQ — horizontally partitioned by contract address
PyTorch Geometric · trained on all known DeFi exploits
GPT-4o / Ollama · RAG over Solidity knowledge graph
Fuzz worker pool — stateless containers, auto-scales 1→N
Result event bus — findings + patches + anomaly flags fan out in parallel
Backend API — Node.js + FastAPI microservices · REST + WebSocket
① Queue partition by contract address → parallel fuzz workers, no shared state
② Workers are stateless containers → Kubernetes HPA scales 1→N on CPU
③ IPFS + on-chain anchoring → storage never bottlenecks on a single DB
